subject.title: fix: recover stranded replies in message_tool_only mode (#85714)

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's opt-in `messages.strandedReplyRecovery` config surface for stranded `message_tool_only` finals, or should the fix use the successor no-new-config default-recovery policy?
rationale: Both paths are plausible: this PR preserves default private behavior but adds a public config knob, while the successor PR removes config growth but changes default recovery behavior for this failure class.

options.title: Fix private metadata, then consider opt-in
options.body: Repair the retry identity first, then merge this branch only if maintainers want an explicit opt-in recovery setting.

options.title: Prefer successor policy
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99536 if maintainers want guarded recovery by default without `messages.strandedReplyRecovery`.

options.title: Keep warning-only behavior
options.body: Reject recovery and leave current main's private-final diagnostic as the supported behavior.

recommendation.title: Fix private metadata, then consider opt-in
recommendation.body: Repair the retry identity first, then merge this branch only if maintainers want an explicit opt-in recovery setting.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the clearest product/privacy routing owner from the warning-only baseline and related maintainer discussion.
